english.note: Use this for a very small amount of something, especially when stressing how tiny it is.
Use this for a very small amount of something abstract or uncountable, such as comfort.
Use this for a tiny amount, degree, or distance when English uses hair to mean just a little.
Use this for a tiny amount or something extremely small, rather than a literal round mark.

examples.english: This soup is so bland it doesn’t have even a sliver of flavor.
examples.traditional: 呢杯湯淡到連一丁點味道都冇。
examples.jyutping: ne1 bui1 tong1 taam5 dou3 lin4 jat1 ding1 dim2 mei6 dou6 dou1 mou5

examples.english: This news did not give me a crumb of comfort.
examples.traditional: 呢個消息連一丁點安慰都冇畀我。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 lin4 jat1 ding1 dim2 on1 wai3 dou1 mou5 bei2 ngo5

examples.english: Move forward just a hair and we’ll fall into the sea.
examples.traditional: 再行前一丁點就跌落海喇。
examples.jyutping: zoi3 haang4 cin4 jat1 ding1 dim2 zau6 dit3 lok6 hoi2 laa3

examples.english: I only want a dot of cream on top.
examples.traditional: 上面加一丁點忌廉就得喇。
examples.jyutping: soeng6 min6 gaa1 jat1 ding1 dim2 gei6 lim4 zau6 dak1 laa3
